categories.title: Getting started
categories.intro: One or two places, one service each: the processes the tutorials build, step by step.

categories.title: Petri net patterns
categories.intro: Forks, joins and loops: classic nets, each place a host of its own and every transition rules installed on it.

categories.title: Claims and inventory
categories.intro: Small business processes whose services decide the route: pay or assess a claim, ship or restock an order.

categories.title: Credit and lending
categories.intro: Credit and fraud checks that run side by side and join at underwriting, and a loan process that launches its own compensation.

categories.title: Healthcare
categories.intro: An emergency department in which patients fork to three departments and join at diagnosis, alongside a triage canary and requests from another hospital.

examples.title: Example 1: one place
examples.description: A service that returns true or false: true ends the token, false sends it round again.

examples.title: The P2 tutorial
examples.description: A stochastic service on node P2: true ends the token, false sends it back to try again.

examples.title: A credit check
examples.description: The service tutorial's process: a credit limit service approves or refers each application.

examples.title: Fork and join
examples.description: P1 forks to P2 and P3, on separate hosts; both must arrive before P4 runs.

examples.title: Double join
examples.description: Three branches, two joins: P4 waits for P2 and P3, then P6 waits for P4 and P5.

examples.title: Insurance claims
examples.description: Triage pays a small claim at once and sends a larger one to Assess, a service called over the internet.

examples.title: Inventory and supplier
examples.description: A stateful inventory ships what it holds; when stock runs out, the supplier restocks it or the order is cancelled.

examples.title: Loan application, with compensation
examples.description: Credit and fraud checks join at underwriting; an abandoned loan signals a second process to withdraw its credit enquiry.

examples.title: Emergency department
examples.description: Triage sends a patient straight to treatment, or to laboratory, cardiology and radiology, which join at diagnosis.

examples.title: Three versions at once
examples.description: The emergency department, a triage canary and federated radiology requests, running together on six hosts.
